name: guild-butler-capture
description: Desktop capture app for Albion Online loot logging — the Guild Butler companion client (macOS + Windows).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node tools/build-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
